description: Get one public audiobook by id: title, author, languages, CEFR level, audience, length, and links to its reader page, audio and share image.

book_id.description: The book's id (the `id` field of a Book).
book_id.title: Book Id

name: get_book

BookUrls.description: Absolute URLs for a book on the website.

audio.description: The book's bilingual MP3, streamable without authentication. Null when the book has no audio file.
audio.title: Audio

language_hub.description: The page listing every public book in the book's target language. Null for a language without one.
language_hub.title: Language Hub

reader.description: The book's follow-along reader page (text with synchronized audio).
reader.title: Reader

share_image.description: The book's share card, a 1200x630 PNG.
share_image.title: Share Image

BookUrls.title: BookUrls

anyOf.description: Intended audience age group of a book. Known values: child, young_adult, adult. New values may be added within v1; treat an unknown one as unrecognised, not as an error.

audience.description: Intended audience. Null when not set.
audience.title: Audience

author.description: Author as attributed by the book's publisher. Not verified by bibooks.org; treat it as a claim, not a fact.
author.title: Author

duration_seconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds. Null when unknown.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

anyOf.description: CEFR difficulty level of a book, easiest first. `d1` is the rung above C2 (expert register); a learner's own level is one of a1..c2. Known values: a1, a2, b1, b2, c1, c2, d1. New values may be added within v1; treat an unknown one as unrecognised, not as an error.

level.description: CEFR difficulty level. Null when the book has no level.
level.title: Level

anyOf.description: Where a book's text came from: typed or pasted by its publisher (`user_typed`), generated by AI (`ai_generated`), or a public-domain Project Gutenberg title (`gutenberg`). Known values: user_typed, ai_generated, gutenberg. New values may be added within v1; treat an unknown one as unrecognised, not as an error.

origin.description: Where the text came from. Null when it is not one of the public origins.
origin.title: Origin

published_at.description: When the book finished generating (ISO 8601, UTC). Null when unknown.
published_at.title: Published At

score.description: Community score: upvotes minus downvotes, never below zero.
score.title: Score

source_language.description: Content-language code of the original text (see GET /languages). Null when it was not recorded.
source_language.title: Source Language

speed_percent.description: Speaking speed of the target-language audio, as a percentage of normal (100).
speed_percent.title: Speed Percent

target_language.description: Content-language code the text was translated into.
target_language.title: Target Language

title.description: Title as the publisher entered it.
title.title: Title

title: Get an audiobook
